description: Official Antigravity CLI (agy) print-mode output. Each fixture is antigravity-<name>.stdout plus antigravity-<name>.exit (the process exit status), and antigravity-<name>.stderr where stderr is the evidence. Headroom keeps no stderr at runtime: it only watches it for the sign-in prompt. origin: live = printed by agy as-is; derived = a live capture with the named fields edited; synthetic = not observed.

fixtures.name: usage-live
fixtures.description: A signed-in account: two groups, four buckets (gemini-weekly 0.9946, gemini-5h 0.9894, 3p-weekly 1, 3p-5h 1), num_turns 0, every token count 0. Contains no email, token or account identifier.

fixtures.name: credits-live
fixtures.description: The same account: remaining_credits 0, num_turns 0, every token count 0.

fixtures.name: usage-signed-out
fixtures.description: Synthetic, modelled on two signed-out probes on 2026-11-16. When agy is signed out, `agy -p "/usage"` does not answer: it prints "Authentication required. Please visit the URL to log in:" and a Google sign-in URL on stderr, opens that sign-in page in the browser and prints "Waiting for authentication (timeout 60s)...". The .stderr file has those lines with the URL replaced by a placeholder; Headroom ends the read at the first line and reports signed out. The .stdout file has the ERROR result shape printed when such a wait ends without the prompt being seen ("authentication failed or timed out"), which stays a transient failure; its exit status 1 is a stand-in, since none was observed.

fixtures.name: usage-missing-3p-5h
fixtures.description: The 3p-5h bucket and its response line removed.

fixtures.name: usage-one-turn
fixtures.description: num_turns set to 1: the answer cost a model turn.

fixtures.name: usage-output-tokens
fixtures.description: output_tokens and total_tokens set to 12: the answer spent tokens.
